issue.title: Change parsing of numeric `to` and `from` parameters in `date_range` aggregation

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
Currently the `to` and `from` parameter in the `date_range` aggregation is not parsed with the correct date field format from the mappings or the aggregation if the argument is numeric, but always treated as a long value specifying `epoch_millis`. This leads to problems e.g. when the format is `epoch_second`, but the `to` and `from` are currently treated as millis.

#Closes #17920
